Q17001405.label: Thirty-second Amendment of the Constitution Bill 2013
Q17001405.desc: To abolish the Seanad, the upper house of the Oireachtas
aliases: Proposed 32nd Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland
Q17001405.wiki: Thirty-second Amendment of the Constitution Bill 2013
Q17001405.summary: The Thirty-second Amendment of the Constitution Bill 2013 was a proposal to amend the Constitution of Ireland to abolish Seanad Éireann, the upper house of the Irish parliament, the Oireachtas. The proposal was rejected by the electorate in a referendum on 4 October 2013 by 51.7% voting against to 48.3% in favour.

Q108601789.label: We Continue the Change
Q108601789.summary: We Continue the Change, sometimes translated as Change Continues or Let's Pursue Change, is a centrist, anti-corruption political party and formerly an electoral alliance in Bulgaria founded by Kiril Petkov and Assen Vassilev. It was founded ahead of the November 2021 election. The party was officially registered on 15 April. The party was a ruling party in Bulgaria during the periods of Kiril Petkov's government and as part of the PP-DB alliance in the Nikolai Denkov government.

Q4128701.label: 1989 Soviet Union legislative election
Q4128701.desc: legislative election in the Soviet Union
Q4128701.summary: Legislative elections were held in the Soviet Union on 26 March 1989 to elect members of the Congress of People's Deputies, with run-offs on 2, 9 and 20 April and 14 and 23 May. They were the first partially free nationwide elections held in the Soviet Union, and would be the last national elections held in that country before its dissolution in 1991.

Party: Communist Party of the Soviet Union

Q834493.label: Chinese Revolutionary Party
Q834493.desc: Political party of the Republic of China
Q834493.summary: The Kuomintang (KMT) is a major political party in the Republic of China (Taiwan). It was the sole ruling party of China from 1928 to 1949 until its relocation to Taiwan, and in Taiwan ruled under martial law until 1987. The KMT is a centre-right to right-wing party and the largest in the Pan-Blue Coalition, one of Taiwan's two main political groups. Its primary rival is the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), the largest party in the Pan-Green Coalition. As of 2025, the KMT is the largest single party in the Legislative Yuan and is chaired by Cheng Li-wun.

Q6102461.label: Escobar Rebellion
Q6102461.desc: conflict in northern Mexico in 1929 during the Maximato
Q6102461.img: Mexican Army In Trenches Siege of Naco Sonora 1929.JPG
Q6102461.summary: The Escobar Rebellion was a conflict in northern Mexico in 1929 during the Maximato, between the government forces of President Emilio Portes Gil and rebel forces under the command of General José Gonzalo Escobar. After some initial success in taking over several key cities in the northern half of the country, the Escobar rebels were decisively defeated in a major battle at Jiménez, Chihuahua, and were eventually swept aside by the advancing government forces under the command of General Calles.

Q1606589.label: Henry Calvert Simons
Q1606589.summary: Henry Calvert Simons was an American economist at the University of Chicago. A protégé of Frank Knight, his antitrust and monetarist models influenced the Chicago school of economics. He was a founding author of the Chicago plan for monetary reform that found broad support in the years following the 1930s Depression, which would have abolished the fractional-reserve banking system, which Simons viewed to be inherently unstable.
